about: Laws that have no researched outcome-web link in data/research/outcome-web/links.json, neither from the law itself nor from a measure an engine sets from it, and the outcome the research would measure. Each carries the stopgap that registers the gap; read by scripts/law-wiring/catalog.ts for the law-wiring matrix. The research belongs to the outcome-web line (pool item laws-outcome-links-unresearched). A row's note records a search that found no sized source.

laws.note: Searched Nov 11, 2026 for a sized link from state authority (or preemption) to the share of cities that adopt a local minimum wage: found NELP's count of 25 preempting states (more than half after 2012) and its estimate of about 346,000 workers in 12 preempted cities and counties, and an Urban Studies paper on a 50-state labor-law dataset whose adoption results were not visible; none sizes an adoption rate with a spread. The outcome is also not a measure the web keeps. Row and stopgap kept.
